title: stats-check writes predictable symlink-following temp files in world-writable /tmp with unvalidated demo name
detail: os.write_entire_file opens O_CREATE|O_TRUNC without O_EXCL and follows symlinks; predictable /tmp names let another local user pre-plant a symlink to clobber dev-writable files. Demo name also interpolates unvalidated into the path.
recommended_fix: Use os.create_temp_file (O_EXCL) or write under gitignored bin/ like overlay-check does; reject demo names containing path separators before interpolation.

title: App accumulates the entire session's stats stream in memory, flushed only at process exit
detail: stats_sb grows on the default allocator for every stepped tick (~tens of MB/hour of play, unbounded); an app crash or kill also loses the whole session's stream. Availability, not confidentiality — stream holds only sim numbers.
recommended_fix: Flush incrementally: open the stats file at launch and append rows per tick (or per N ticks) instead of buffering the session in memory until exit.

title: App silently ignores a dangling --stats-out token that the harness rejects with a usage error
detail: `app --stats-out` with no path token silently runs with telemetry off; the spec matrix says missing path token → usage error, and the harness enforces exactly that. Inconsistent CLI-boundary validation for the same flag.
recommended_fix: When --stats-out is the last argument with no following token, print a usage error and exit non-zero before InitWindow, mirroring the harness parse.
